index_headline: Send a secret that automatically disappears
index_subtitle: Your message is encrypted in your browser, so no one else can read it - not even us. It can only be opened once, with a link and password you share yourself. After that, it's gone for good.
index_how_it_works_step_1: Your message is encrypted in your browser, before it ever leaves your device
index_how_it_works_step_2: Only the encrypted data is uploaded to the server
index_how_it_works_step_3: You share the link and the password with your recipient
index_how_it_works_step_4: Your recipient opens it once - then it self-destructs
index_enter_message_placeholder:
Write your secret here…

Don't worry - nothing is sent anywhere until you click "Encrypt & Create Link".
index_error_creating_drop: We encountered an issue creating your message link. Please try again - nothing was sent and your text is still here.
index_drop_made_success: Your message is ready - encrypted and secure!
index_drop_made_description: Send the full message below to your recipient - they'll need both the link and the password to open it.
drop_message_2_kicker: I'm sending you something private. You can read it here:
drop_message_6_description_1: This link works only once. Keep the password safe, and copy the message right away.
drop_message_7_description_2: As soon as it's opened - with the right password or without it - the data is permanently deleted.
drop_message_8_description_3_time: The link also expires after %1$d hours; the data is erased then, too.
pickup_kicker_1: This message is locked. Enter the password the sender shared with you.
pickup_kicker_2: For your safety, this link works only once - after you submit the password, the data is deleted, whether the password was correct or not.
pickup_error_possible_reasons_bullet_poi: The message has already been opened.
pickup_error_security_warning_text: If you weren't expecting it to be opened yet, treat the message as compromised and ask the sender for a new one.
pickup_hint_encrypt_yourself: Want to send your own secret? Click here.
toast_clipboard_copy_error: Couldn't copy - please copy it manually.
html_meta_description: Send a message that disappears after it's read - encrypted, one-time, no account needed.
